selected_script.angle: Utilizing the side of the refrigerator to stop spices and small tools from falling down the narrow gap between the counter and fridge
selected_script.hook: Stop losing your expensive spice jars and utensils down that dark gap next to your refrigerator.

video_001_part_01.description: 0-3s: A close-up of a kitchen counter next to a refrigerator where a hand reaches for a spice jar and knocks it down the narrow gap between the fridge and counter. 3-6s: A matte black rectangular metal magnetic spice rack is snapped onto the side of the refrigerator. 6-10s: Several spice jars are placed securely inside the rack, showing them safe and organized.

video_001_part_02.description: 0-4s: A second matte black rack is shown on the fridge, holding oil bottles, with two detachable metal hooks holding measuring spoons underneath. 4-8s: A hand easily pulls a jar from the rack, showing it stays perfectly in place on the fridge side. 8-10s: The camera pulls back to show the clean fridge side setup with the light CTA overlay.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, shot on a realistic handheld phone. Use the provided product reference images showing the matte black carbon steel rectangular rack with a high back plate and a lower front retaining wall. Timeline: 0-3s (Pain Conflict): Close-up of a messy kitchen counter edge next to a refrigerator. A hand tries to grab a spice jar but accidentally knocks it and a spatula down the dark, narrow gap between the fridge and the counter. 3-6s (Product Solution): Instantly introduce the matte black metal magnetic rack. A hand snaps the flat back plate of the rack onto the metal side of the refrigerator above the counter. 6-10s (Fast-cut Scene 1): Show the spice jars placed neatly inside the secure, matte black metal rack on the fridge side. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, shot on a realistic handheld phone. This segment must be the continuation of the previous 10-second segment, maintaining the identical matte black carbon steel rack, kitchen background, lighting, and pacing. Timeline: 0-4s (Fast-cut Scene 2): Show a second matte black magnetic rack mounted on the side of the refrigerator. It holds oil bottles, and two detachable metal hooks hang from the bottom edge holding measuring spoons. 4-8s (Fast-cut Scene 3): Close-up of a hand easily lifting a spice jar from the rack without the rack slipping or sliding on the fridge surface. 8-10s (CTA): The camera pulls back slightly to show the clean side of the fridge with the racks. Voiceover or overlay text: 'Keep your kitchen spices secure and within reach. Check it out today.'
